text: A lot of it comes down to upbringing. If you grew up seeing your parents help neighbours or give lifts to people, it feels completely natural to do the same. But I think the situation matters too. Psychologists talk about the bystander effect — when lots of people are around, each person assumes someone else will step in, so ironically, you're less likely to get help in a crowd.

tips.en: Upbringing and situation give a personal and a general explanation.
tips.kk: Тәрбие және жағдай — жеке және жалпы түсіндірме.
tips.ru: Воспитание и ситуация — личное и общее объяснение.
tips.example: A lot of it comes down to upbringing

tips.en: The bystander effect, explained, shows a high level of vocabulary.
tips.kk: Түсіндірмесі бар bystander effect — лексиканың жоғары деңгейі.
tips.ru: Bystander effect с объяснением — высокий уровень лексики.
tips.example: Psychologists talk about the bystander effect

questions.followUp: Did you learn this from your family?
questions.question: Why do some people help strangers while others don't?

text: In my experience, they're not less kind, but they're definitely busier and more cautious. In a village, everyone knows each other, so helping someone is also a way of keeping good relationships. In a big city, people are in a hurry and they're more worried about scams, so they might walk past someone in trouble. That said, when there's a real emergency, city people usually react very quickly.

tips.en: Not less kind, but busier refines the idea in the question.
tips.kk: Not less kind, but … busier — сөйлеуші сұрақтың өз идеясын нақтылайды.
tips.ru: Not less kind, but … busier — говорящий уточняет саму идею вопроса.
tips.example: they're not less kind, but they're definitely busier and more cautious

tips.en: Village and city each come with their own reason.
tips.kk: Ауыл мен қала — әрқайсысының өз себебі бар.
tips.ru: Деревня и город — у каждого своя причина.
tips.example: In a village, everyone knows each other

questions.question: Are people less helpful in big cities than in small towns?

text: I can see the logic, because many teenagers would never try volunteering unless they had to, and some of them might discover they really enjoy it. However, I think making it compulsory could backfire. If students are forced to collect a certain number of hours, it becomes just another box to tick. A better approach might be to offer lots of options and give credit to those who take part.

tips.en: I can see the logic politely accepts the other side before disagreeing.
tips.kk: I can see the logic — екінші жақты сыпайы қабылдап, сосын қарсы шығу.
tips.ru: I can see the logic — вежливо принять другую сторону, потом возразить.

tips.en: A better approach might be offers a solution instead of a simple no.
tips.kk: A better approach might be — жай «жоқ» орнына ұсыныс.
tips.ru: A better approach might be — предложение вместо простого «нет».
tips.example: A better approach might be to offer lots of options

note.en: “Something done only because it is required”.

text: In quite a few ways, actually. Online fundraising means that if a family needs money for an operation, thousands of people can contribute within a day, which would have been impossible before. There are also neighbourhood chats where people offer to pick up medicine for elderly residents or lend tools. So technology doesn't replace kindness, but it makes it much easier to act on.

tips.en: Fundraising and neighbourhood chats — one big and one everyday example.
tips.kk: Қаражат жинау және көршілер чаты — ірі және күнделікті мысал.
tips.ru: Сбор денег и соседские чаты — крупный и бытовой пример.

tips.en: Doesn't replace …, but makes it easier is a careful conclusion.
tips.kk: Doesn't replace …, but makes it easier — ұқыпты тұжырым.
tips.ru: Doesn't replace …, but makes it easier — аккуратная формулировка.
tips.example: technology doesn't replace kindness, but it makes it much easier to act on

questions.question: How can technology help people support each other?

text: I'd say the government has the main responsibility, because only the state has the resources to provide things like pensions, healthcare and housing on a large scale. Communities can't replace that. However, they can fill the gaps, because they notice problems much faster — a neighbour will know if an elderly man hasn't left his flat for three days long before any official does.

tips.en: A view with a reason: only the state has the resources.
tips.kk: Себебі бар ұстаным: ресурс тек мемлекетте бар.
tips.ru: Позиция с причиной: ресурсы есть только у государства.
tips.example: only the state has the resources

tips.en: Fill the gaps plus a vivid example about a neighbour.
tips.kk: Fill the gaps және көрші туралы жанды мысал.
tips.ru: Fill the gaps и живой пример с соседом.
tips.example: a neighbour will know if an elderly man hasn't left his flat for three days
